locations: Section 2.2, printed pages 13-15: analytic hydraulic models and parameter definitions
Section 3.1, printed pages 17-21: Dutch soil classes, including organic soils
Table 3, printed pages 23-24: six class parameters and their units
Table 4, printed pages 25-28: computed hydraulic curves, not independent observations

material_basis.meaning: Bulk soil represented by the selected original Staring class, including mineral and organic classes.
material_basis.compatibility_policy: Exact material equality remains required; soil does not silently match mineral_soil, fine_earth or unspecified.

decisions: All six Table 3 outputs are estimated model parameters, not observations or confidence bounds.
The class identifier retains the original 36-class Dutch Staring classification; no USDA or Russian texture crosswalk is introduced.
Water contents use volume_fraction, conductivity uses centimeter_per_day, alpha uses inverse_centimeter, l and n are dimensionless.
The retention adapter uses theta_r, theta_s, alpha and n with m = 1 - 1/n and nonnegative pressure-head magnitude in centimeters.
The adapter is restricted to the explicitly reviewed class-parameter function; matching output names do not establish model equivalence.
Conductivity parameters are retained in the manifest but conductivity evaluation is outside this adapter.
No formulas, coefficients, class values, computational target code or function status are changed.

real_dataset_status.claim: Manifest inclusion enables evaluation on compatible datasets; it does not establish eligibility for this workbook.
